title: 六级长对话：排班试行与字幕协作
instruction: 听完整一节两段长对话及各段后读出的问题，依次选择最佳答案。音频中材料和问题各读一遍，卷面只印四个选项。本原创使用节内编号1—8，各段对应1—4、5—8题。播放器可回听，正式单次听辨条件未强制。
audio_introduction: Section A. You will hear two long conversations. After each, you will hear questions. Each recording and each question will be spoken only once. Choose the best answer from A, B, C and D.
source_form_notice: 六级形式参照2024年12月第一套转载Section A：2段、4/4共8回应、每题四选；原创采用节内编号，问题只在录音与作者区。全部自有虚构内容及本机合成试听，非原考试原声；未独立教研/听辨/学生难度或产品等值验证。

turns.speaker: W
turns.text: The management team seems pleased with the four-day schedule trial. They say output stayed level even though people were here on fewer days. Are we ready to make it permanent?

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: I wouldn't jump to that conclusion. The trial involved the design team, whose work can often be arranged around projects. The customer support team still needs someone available every weekday.

turns.speaker: W
turns.text: Couldn't support staff simply take different days off? That would maintain coverage.

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: Possibly. But their handover time would increase, and we haven't included that in the figures. I'm not against the schedule. I just think we've tested one version of it in one department.

turns.speaker: W
turns.text: The staff questionnaire was positive too. Nearly everyone on the trial said they wanted to continue.

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: That matters, but remember they volunteered. People who thought the arrangement would be awkward could choose to stay outside it. We shouldn't assume the same response from everyone.

turns.speaker: W
turns.text: So you think the result is useless?

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: Not at all. It shows that this team could maintain its recorded output for eight weeks. That's worth knowing. It doesn't show what happens when a project runs late or when someone takes annual leave. The trial happened during a relatively quiet period.

turns.speaker: W
turns.text: What would you propose? Another questionnaire?

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: A second trial that includes a support group and a busier period. We should record handover hours as well as completed work, and let people report problems without having to defend their original choice.

turns.speaker: W
turns.text: That will delay the announcement the director wants to make next month.

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: We can announce the promising result now and explain what still needs testing. A cautious statement isn't the same as a negative one.

turns.speaker: W
turns.text: All right. I'll revise the briefing so the questionnaire is presented as feedback from volunteers, and ask the support manager to help design the next stage.

questions.spoken_question: What is the man's main reservation about making the schedule permanent?
options: The trial has already reduced the design team's output.
All support staff have refused to change their schedules.
The current evidence comes from a limited trial setting.
The director has prohibited any further experimentation.
questions.rationale: C：单一设计部门、志愿者、八周淡季，外推有限；A记录产出未降；B未试支持部门，非已拒绝；D希望公告，未禁试验。

questions.spoken_question: Why does the man qualify the positive questionnaire result?
options: Participants chose to join the trial in the first place.
The questions were written in a language staff could not read.
The support manager destroyed the negative responses.
Most volunteers failed to submit a completed questionnaire.
questions.rationale: A：自愿参加有选择效应；B/C/D均无依据，未指控语言障碍/销毁/大规模缺答。

questions.spoken_question: What does the man recommend recording in the next trial?
options: Only the number of people requesting annual leave.
The handover time as well as completed work.
Only staff opinions collected before the trial begins.
questions.rationale: B：记录交接小时和完成工作；A年假是未测情境而非唯一指标；C日期非表现指标；D非只事前意见。

questions.spoken_question: What will the woman do after the discussion?
options: Cancel the trial results before anyone can see them.
Announce that the schedule is unsuitable for every department.
Replace the volunteer feedback with invented company-wide figures.
Revise the briefing and involve the support manager in further testing.
questions.rationale: D：修订briefing标明志愿者反馈、邀支持经理设计下一阶段；A未撤结果；B可谨慎积极公告；C不编全员统计。

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: We've received an offer from a volunteer group to produce subtitles for the local history interviews. It could help us release the whole series sooner.

turns.speaker: W
turns.text: That's welcome, but have they seen how much work is involved? We have twelve interviews, and some speakers use local expressions that are difficult even for our editors.

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: They've translated material for community events before. I thought we could divide the interviews among them and do a quick check at the end.

turns.speaker: W
turns.text: Experience is useful, but independent versions could use different names for the same places. Viewers might think two speakers were talking about different locations when they weren't.

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: Would a shared list of names solve that?

turns.speaker: W
turns.text: It would help. I'd also begin with one short interview, reviewed jointly by a volunteer and our editor. That would let us agree on how much speech to shorten for a readable subtitle without changing its meaning.

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: I'm concerned we'll spend more time organizing than we save. The first episode is supposed to appear in three weeks.

turns.speaker: W
turns.text: Then subtitle that episode first. The broadcast date doesn't require every interview to be ready at once. If we rush twelve versions now, correcting inconsistent choices later could take longer.

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: Fair enough. What about crediting the volunteers? Their coordinator asked whether individual names could appear.

turns.speaker: W
turns.text: Certainly, with their agreement. But a credit shouldn't imply that a volunteer has approved every editorial change we make afterwards. We need to show the final version to the person who worked on it.

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: And if somebody can't finish on time?

turns.speaker: W
turns.text: We should have a clear handover arrangement, rather than quietly removing their name or expecting another unpaid person to work through the night.

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: I'll discuss a one-interview pilot with the coordinator, including the names list and how final versions are approved. We can set a realistic schedule for the rest after that.

questions.spoken_question: What concern does the woman raise about dividing the interviews immediately?
options: The volunteers have demanded payment for every minute of footage.
Different versions may handle the same place names inconsistently.
None of the volunteers has worked on community material.
The broadcaster has already canceled the interview series.
questions.rationale: B：相同地名不同译称会误导观众；A未要求付费；C有人社区翻译经验；D未取消。

questions.spoken_question: What is the purpose of reviewing a short interview together first?
options: To test whether the recording equipment still works.
To prove that local expressions should always be omitted.
To agree on readable shortening and consistent editorial choices.
To decide which volunteer should receive all the public credit.
questions.rationale: C：共同商定压缩口语但不改意的方式，加名称表；A非设备试机；B未一律删除地方表达；D非独占署名选拔。

questions.spoken_question: How does the woman respond to the approaching broadcast date?
options: She suggests preparing the first episode before the remaining interviews.
She proposes releasing all interviews without subtitles.
She says the volunteer group must work overnight until all versions are ready.
She argues that the whole series should be postponed indefinitely.
questions.rationale: A：先字幕首集，不需十二全同步；B未取消字幕；C明确不强迫无偿熬夜；D非无限延期。

questions.spoken_question: What does the woman say about naming volunteers in the credits?
options: Their names should be removed if an editor changes a single word.
A credit automatically proves approval of every later change.
Individual names should never appear on community projects.
They should agree to the credit and see the final edited version.
questions.rationale: D：同意署名且看最终版；A不应悄然撤名；B署名不自动等于批准后改；C可个人署名，不是一律禁止。
